name: code-is-two-lib-fixture
description: #198 — two `code is` libraries under ONE policy id. The entry library (`main.crl`) chains `use decision "Two Lib Sub"."Sub Determination"` into a vendored sibling (`sub.crl`) that ALSO declares concept-level `code is`. Under Option B the PRIMARY (closure seed) keeps the clean `<policyId>-local` local CodeSystem + base identity; the cross-lib SIBLING is disambiguated to `<policyId>-<librarySlug>-local`, so the two libraries emit to TWO distinct local CodeSystems + base/layered Libraries instead of colliding on one canonical url.
